newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Cagamas 92-day average yield 6.87 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Cagamas 92-day average yield 6.87 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's national mortgage corporation, Cagamas Bhd, announced on Friday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.87 percent at its auction of 92-day notes to raise 200 million ringgit.
It said the bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.90 and 6.815 percent.
Cagamas said that against its tender for 182-day notes, it accepted bids at an average 6.866 percent to raise 650 million ringgit.
The bids were in the high/low range of 6.90 and 6.77 percent, Cagamas said.
Money market dealers said payment for almost the entire amount being raised would be met by maturing Cagamas issues.
